Chapter 335: Chapter 3 The ‘King’ of the Black Mist Mountain Range (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan fell into deep thought.

Of course, although he had not cultivated the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, this did not affect Lin Yuan’s ability to use his Against-Heaven’s Understanding to infer and perfect the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Moreover, some essences of the Demon Tree were highly referential to the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and could be perfectly integrated into it.

“Outer Domain Battlefield of Evil Gods…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze drifted towards the outer domain.

Under the instinctive perception from the Demon Tree, there was an abyss-like aura there, precisely the location of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

...

“The Ancestral Demon Tree wants to invade this world, but it’s not going smoothly…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Fifty years had passed, and he had not sensed the Ancestral Demon Tree advancing even a bit; it was clearly blocked.

For the invader, this was a disadvantage; the Tianqing World had the backing of an entire world.

That could continuously send cultivators to resist.

And the Ancestral Demon Tree? Even as a Foreign Evil God with a strong essence, it was, after all, just an individual.

In terms of foundation? It simply couldn’t compete with a complete world.

“For now, it has nothing to do with me…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; in this traversal, he had six hundred years to stay in this world; so far, only fifty had passed, not even one-tenth, and he still had plenty of time to cultivate.

The deadlock between the Tianqing World and the Ancestral Demon Tree was a good thing for Lin Yuan.

If the latter were to come to this world before Lin Yuan had grown to surpass the Ancestral Demon Tree, it would be bad.

That’s why over these fifty years, Lin Yuan had devoured countless demonic beasts in the Black Mist Mountain Range but had deliberately avoided human cultivators.

One reason was the fear of being discovered to be abnormal.

The other was his reluctance to weaken the strength of human cultivators.

As of now, Lin Yuan still needed countless cultivators from the Tianqing Alliance to sacrifice their lives in resisting the invasion of the Ancestral Demon Tree, buying him time to grow.

“However, recently I have awakened a power of the Ancestral Demon Tree…”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, and the branches of the Demon Tree swayed, as a gray and plain seed floated before him.

Demon Tree Seed.

Lying beyond the domain, the Ancestral Demon Tree constantly scattered seeds that turned into Evil God Puppets, battling against the powerhouses of the Tianqing World.

As the legitimate offspring of the Ancestral Demon Tree, once Lin Yuan grew to a certain extent and escaped the world’s suppression, he could naturally produce seeds.

Lin Yuan gazed at the grayish seed before him, the seed of the demon.

Up to now, Lin Yuan had perceived three functions of the demon seed.

The first was to directly transform into a Demon Puppet.

That was the method currently used by the Ancestral Demon Tree, using its vast Primordial Qi to nurture the demon seeds, making them quickly grow into Evil God Puppets.

The second was parasitism, where the demon seed could parasitize within a living being, thereby controlling it.

The third was natural growth, by scattering seeds onto fertile soil, where the seeds would take root and sprout.

Lin Yuan’s predecessor, the Demon Tree, was bred using the third method by the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Each method had its advantages and disadvantages, but only the third method could truly be regarded as offspring of the Ancestral Demon Tree, capable of inheriting some of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s innate abilities.

“The first function of the demon seed is of no use to me…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; using his own Primordial Qi to nurture the growth of the Demon Tree seed was not suitable for the current Lin Yuan.

What kind of being was the Ancestral Demon Tree? Dominating beyond the domain and amassing a robust accumulation, it dared to use its vast Primordial Qi to nurture demon seeds.

But how many years had Lin Yuan accumulated? Besides, if he had sufficient Primordial Qi, Lin Yuan would directly enhance himself instead of cultivating something like puppets.

And the third effect of the demon seed was even more unnecessary.

Even the seeds of the Ancestral Demon Tree, scattered to the Tianqing World, mostly died, not to mention the seeds of Lin Yuan, offspring of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

“Parasitism…”

Lin Yuan pondered over the second function of the demon seed.

It could parasitize within a certain living creature, controlling it.

This ability required many prerequisite conditions, the most important being that the host had no ability to resist.

Otherwise, the parasitism would fail.

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred.

Thousands of miles away.

A Purple-Eyed Rabbit cautiously poked its head out, gazing at a spiritual herb not far away with a hint of longing in its eyes.

Whoosh.

The Purple-Eyed Rabbit looked around, didn’t spot any danger, and with a whoosh, it lunged towards the spiritual herb.

However, just at that moment.

A black tree trunk protruded from the ground, directly capturing the Purple-Eyed Rabbit and pulling it back underground.

It was all over in just a moment.

Purple-Eyed Rabbit then appeared in front of Lin Yuan.

“Squeak, squeak….”

The Purple-Eyed Rabbit emitted a trembling sound as it looked at the massive figure in front of it, continuously turning in circles where it stood.

“I’ll use you to test the parasitic effect,” Lin Yuan said.

Lin Yuan watched the Purple-Eyed Rabbit as a dusty gray seed fell down and precisely landed on the rabbit.

Buzz.

The Purple-Eyed Rabbit collapsed to the ground with a thud.

And that dusty gray Demon Tree Seed quickly permeated the Purple-Eyed Rabbit’s head.

A moment later,

The Purple-Eyed Rabbit was thoroughly controlled; it stood up stiffly and emitted a deeply respectful spiritual wave of submission toward Lin Yuan.

“This feeling….”

Lin Yuan observed the Purple-Eyed Rabbit, and under his control, it continuously performed various actions, whether rolling or running.

“It’s not bad,” Lin Yuan nodded slightly. At this time, the Purple-Eyed Rabbit was not dead; it was still alive, but it had been replaced by the Demon Tree Seed.

“It’s just….”

“This is too obvious….”

Lin Yuan looked at the Purple-Eyed Rabbit. The rabbit, parasitized by the demon seed, had stiff limbs, a dull gaze, and even its movements gave off a sluggish illusion.

It would be easy for others to notice something was amiss.

“No wonder the Ancestral Demon Tree did not utilize the seeds’ parasitic ability; it is indeed somewhat limited,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The parasitic ability of the Demon Tree Seed, although it does not require the expenditure of Primordial Qi to activate, has many limitations. The first of these is that the host must not resist.

If they are unable to resist, why not kill them and consume them directly? Why waste energy on parasitism?

Moreover, after parasitism, while certainly under control, the manifestation is extremely obvious. In the Tianqing World, it would be difficult for powerful beings not to notice.

“However… this parasitic ability, can I possibly improve and perfect it with Against-Heaven’s Understanding?” Lin Yuan mused and fell into brief thought.

Right after his arrival in this world, Lin Yuan, with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, devised a method suited for cultivating with the Demon Tree Seed.

Now with this Demon Tree Seed, Lin Yuan could certainly perform improvements.

Of course, the Demon Tree Seed is a natural ability of the Demon Tree,

Improving and perfecting it would be difficult, but with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan could still give it a try.

…

In the following period,

Lin Yuan focused on four areas.

One was to continue enhancing his own strength, consuming more demonic and fierce beasts, propelling his own growth.

Two was to perfect the Martial Path Evolutionary Path Seventh Rank Chapter.

Three was to comprehend the remaining core space models.

Though he lost the environment of frequent spatial fluctuations like those in the Battlefields of Different Species, Lin Yuan’s speed in comprehending core space models decreased.

But Lin Yuan now had more time. With six hundred years of residency and Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan could raise his comprehension of Space Rules to an unimaginable level.

As for four, it was to attempt improving the Demon Tree Seed.

Even though for the Ancestral Demon Tree, the Demon Tree Seed was an extremely important method, Lin Yuan still planned to spend some energy and time on this aspect.

He would be delighted with any gains; even if there were none in the end, there would be no loss.

Time again passed by.

Suddenly it was another period later.

Deep within the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Lin Yuan’s form rose another ten meters; the Demon Tree was now nearly reaching a height of fifty meters, with dangling branches and swaying canopy, extremely extraordinary.

This was even with Lin Yuan greatly suppressing its growth; if he had allowed it to grow freely, the Demon Tree would be at least hundreds or thousands of meters tall by now.

It’s important to note that the Ancestral Demon Tree in the outer domain didn’t know how many tens of thousands of meters tall it was, and millions upon millions of Demon Tree Seeds grew on just one of its branches.

Otherwise, it would not have been able to contend with the Tianqing World until now.

“For now, I’ve reached a temporary limit in strength,”

“From now on, consuming ordinary demonic beasts would not yield much effect,” Lin Yuan’s spiritual waves slowly expanded as he gazed into the depths of the Black Mist Mountain Range,

That was the location of the supreme ‘King’ of the Black Mist Mountain Range.
